name: Hugh Daigle
text: Nice fallstreak hole over ATX this afternoon (taken from Lamar & 24th). Explanation in alt text.
imageAlt: A fallstreak hole, which is a circular hole in high clouds caused by something, usually an aircraft, that passes through and causes supercooled water droplets to condense and freeze. In this photo there is a plume of ice crystals descending from the hole and getting blown to the left
